title: Synthetic first tokenized-listing platform
description: This project-authored synthetic market resolves Yes if Robinhood is first among Robinhood, Coinbase, Kraken, and Gemini to let a U.S. customer in at least one state purchase a token representing a U.S. exchange-listed stock or ETF after September 17, 2026 and by December 31, 2027, 23:59 ET. Announcements and tests do not qualify. If platforms qualify on the same ET calendar day, earlier purchasability wins; if that order cannot be established, earlier public confirmation wins. Otherwise it resolves No.
